title: Revision print configurations
description: Store immutable PrintConfigurationRevision records for paper size, scale, orientation, media type, feed source, duplex state, and page-decoration choices.
acceptanceCriteria: Each configuration revision references one setup and represents every required print-dialog assumption as known or explicit unknown
Editing appends a revision and never changes a prior referenced configuration
Scale and paper-size values are validated without claiming the browser inspected the print dialog
Configuration lineage and values survive reload

steps.details: Add a versioned immutable PrintConfigurationRevision with exact PRD fields, explicit unknown states, lineage, provenance, and timestamps.
Add pure validation for finite dimensions/scale and supported enum states while allowing honest unknown assumptions.
Implement initial and successor creation in IndexedDB while preventing mutation or deletion of referenced history.
Add focused contract and keyboard browser tests for complete/incomplete configurations, validation, revision history, and restart.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; reuse the loading-revision structure and focused fixture pattern.
These are recorded assumptions only; browser code cannot inspect or control print-dialog values.
Do not add direct printer APIs, silent printing, or dialog automation.
